svg.title: Travel Agent Planner multi-agent architecture
svg.desc: Five prompt agents in Azure AI Foundry Agent Service, all guarded by one RAI policy: a manager agent on gpt-5.6-luna and four specialist agents on gpt-5-mini for the knowledge base, web search, weather and hotels. A Magentic workflow in the local client asks for the user name, calls every agent, runs the weather and hotel function tools against the Visual Crossing and Tavily APIs, detects the language of each question with Azure AI Language, stores the user profile, preferences and conversation history in Azure Cosmos DB and converts the final answer to speech with Azure AI Speech. Every local script reads its endpoints, names and keys from Azure Key Vault. Setup scripts deploy the Azure resources to Switzerland North, build the knowledge base and create the agents.
svg.text: Five Azure AI Foundry prompt agents orchestrated by a local Magentic workflow · user memory in Cosmos DB · language detection with Azure AI Language · every setting and key in Key Vault
